facts.fact: FADCOM, Angola's communications development fund, announced in April 2024 its 'Cogumelo' project to bring internet within two months to the commune of Ucua in Bengo province, through a solar-powered community centre.

systems.system: FADCOM (Fundo de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento das Comunicacoes)
systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Technologies
systems.tiers: funded by 1 per cent of operator revenues

facts.fact: FADCOM, the public fund fed by contributions equal to 1 per cent from electronic communications operators, said in April 2024 it is financing the Cogumelo internet project in Ucua, an investment of about ten million kwanzas.

AGO.note: Startups are only partners in a renewable-energy project; no startup law, label or fund.
A community internet centre is not a technology hub, incubator or park.
